commands.command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch --prune origin; test "$(git rev-parse origin/develop)" = "e4a8f31288eb7f000643cecdd6c5351510a89ce6"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

set -euo pipefail; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

p=Path('platformio.ini'); s=p.read_text(); old='-DAPP_VERSION=\\"1.0.0\\"'; new='-DAPP_VERSION=\\"1.0.1\\"'; assert s.count(old)==1; p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))

p=Path('interface/package.json'); s=p.read_text(); old='\t"version": "1.0.0",'; new='\t"version": "1.0.1",'; assert s.count(old)==1; p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))

p=Path('interface/package-lock.json'); s=p.read_text();
old1='\t"version": "1.0.0",\n\t"lockfileVersion"'; new1='\t"version": "1.0.1",\n\t"lockfileVersion"';
old2='\t\t\t"version": "1.0.0",\n\t\t\t"dependencies"'; new2='\t\t\t"version": "1.0.1",\n\t\t\t"dependencies"';
assert s.count(old1)==1; assert s.count(old2)==1; s=s.replace(old1,new1,1).replace(old2,new2,1); p.write_text(s)

p=Path('github.md'); s=p.read_text(); anchor='- Nie nadpisuj ani nie cofaj lokalnych zmian uzytkownika bez wyraznej prosby.\n'; addition='- Nie merguj `main` z powrotem do `develop` tylko po to, aby zsynchronizowac snapshot wydania.\n- Po wydaniu zsynchronizuj do `develop` tylko metadane bazowej wersji (np. `APP_VERSION` i wersje pakietu), jesli release podbil je wylacznie na `main`.\n- Rozbieznosc historii `main` i `develop` jest oczekiwana w tym modelu: `main` przechowuje snapshoty wydan, a `develop` szczegolowa historie rozwoju.\n'; assert anchor in s; p.write_text(s.replace(anchor,anchor+addition,1))

p=Path('AGENTS.md'); s=p.read_text(); anchor='- Set `work_branch` explicitly. Follow MatrixHub Git policy: normal development is on `develop`; `main` is the stable release line unless the user explicitly requests another branch.\n'; addition='- For release snapshots and post-release branch synchronization, follow `github.md`; do not merge `main` back into `develop` merely to import a release snapshot.\n'; assert anchor in s; p.write_text(s.replace(anchor,anchor+addition,1))
PY
files=$(git diff --name-only); printf '%s\n' "$files"; test "$(printf '%s\n' "$files" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 5; test -z "$(printf '%s\n' "$files" | grep -v -E '^(AGENTS.md|github.md|interface/package-lock.json|interface/package.json|platformio.ini)$' || true)"; git diff --check; git diff --stat

commands.command: set -euo pipefail; git add AGENTS.md github.md interface/package-lock.json interface/package.json platformio.ini; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Sync develop with 1.0.1 release baseline'; git fetch origin develop; test "$(git rev-parse origin/develop)" = "e4a8f31288eb7f000643cecdd6c5351510a89ce6"; git push origin HEAD:develop; echo NEW_DEVELOP=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
